name: fixpointlinux.org
description: The static landing page for **fixpoint-linux** — a Linux system that is a fixed point.

scripts.build: (cd mfe-framework && npm ci && npm run build) && rm -rf vendor/@mfe && mkdir -p vendor/@mfe/core vendor/@mfe/framework && cp mfe-framework/packages/core/dist/*.js vendor/@mfe/core/ && cp mfe-framework/packages/framework/dist/*.js vendor/@mfe/framework/ && elm make src/Main.elm --output=dist/elm.js --optimize && node scripts/ssg.mjs
